messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex V, Part B, point 4

4. Object of the declaration (identification of partly completed machinery allowing traceability; where necessary for the identification of the partly completed machinery, a colour image of sufficient clarity may be included).

response.text:
Object of the declaration | must identify | partly completed machinery in a way that allows traceability | | Object of the declaration (identification of partly completed machinery allowing traceability
Colour image | may be included in | the declaration of incorporation | where necessary for identification of the partly completed machinery | where necessary for the identification of the partly completed machinery, a colour image of sufficient clarity may be included
Colour image | must be of | sufficient clarity | if included in the declaration | a colour image of sufficient clarity may be included
